title: C. elegans Embryo Dissociation for FACS Isolation and RNA-seq Analysis
author: Robert TP Williams
materials: Prepare reagents in advance L15-10 Buffer: Mix 500 ml Leibovitz's L-15 Medium, 50 ml Fetal Bovine Serum (heat inactivated), 50 ul of 100x Penicillin-Streptomycin solution and 7.7 g sucrose. Filter with 0.2 micron pore filter. Store at 4ºC. Egg Buffer: Mix 29.5 ml of 2M NaCl, 12 ml of 2M KCl, 1 ml of 1M CaCl2, 1 ml of MgCl2, 12.5 ml of 1M HEPES-NaOH pH 7.2 and 435 ml molecular grade water. Filter with 0.2 micron pore filter. Store at 4ºC. Chitinase solution (1 U/ml): Dissolve 5 units of Chitinase from Streptomyces griseus (Sigma C6137-5UN) in 5 ml of Egg Buffer. Nutate the solution for approximately 10 minutes until dissolved. Prepare 1 ml aliquots in 1.5 ml tubes. Store aliquots at -20ºC. Pronase E solution (15 mg/ml): Weigh 150 mg of Protease from Streptomyces griseus (Sigma P8811-1G) into a 15 ml tube. Dissolve the enzyme in 10 ml of Egg Buffer. Nutate the solution for approximately 10 minutes until dissolved. Prepare 1 ml aliquots in 1.5 ml tubes. Store aliquots at -20ºC.

steps.title: Prepare equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Cool the swinging‑bucket centrifuge to 4 °C, thaw pronase and chitinase aliquots at room temperature, and place L15‑10 media and egg buffer on ice.

steps.title: Pellet embryos from suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the worm suspension (from a 15 ml tube) to a centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 2000 rcf for 1 minute in a swinging‑bucket rotor to collect the embryo pellet.

steps.title: Aliquot embryo pellet for RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µl of the embryo pellet to 1 ml Qiazol and store at –80 °C for downstream RNA analysis.

steps.title: Wash embryos in M9
steps.instruction: Resuspend the embryo pellet in 1 ml M9, transfer to a 1.5 ml tube, then pellet the embryos at 200 rcf for 5 minutes in a fixed‑angle rotor centrifuge.

steps.title: Resuspend embryos in chitinase solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the embryo pellet (≤200 µl, or double volume if larger) in 0.5 ml egg buffer plus 1 ml chitinase (1 U ml⁻¹).

steps.title: Incubate for eggshell digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the chitinase suspension for 20 minutes at room temperature with gentle rotation or nutation.

steps.title: Verify chitinase digestion microscopically
steps.instruction: Observe a 2 µl sample of the chitinase‑treated embryos under a fluorescent microscope; early embryos should change shape and pretzel‑stage embryos should release from their eggshell.

steps.title: Resuspend embryos in pronase mix
steps.instruction: Resuspend the chitinase‑treated embryo pellet in 200 µl pronase (15 mg ml⁻¹) and 500 µl egg buffer.

steps.title: Attach needle to syringe
steps.instruction: Attach a 21‑gauge, 1¼‑inch needle to a sterile 1 ml syringe.

steps.title: Disrupt vitelline membrane
steps.instruction: Pass the embryo suspension through the attached needle 100 times to break the vitelline membrane and generate a worm slurry.

steps.title: Quench pronase activity
steps.instruction: Add 800 µl L15‑10 media to the worm slurry to quench the pronase reaction.

steps.title: Wash worm slurry
steps.instruction: Wash away excess pronase from the worm slurry (e.g., by adding buffer and gently mixing).

steps.title: Pellet worm slurry
steps.instruction: Pellet the worm slurry at 500 rcf for 5 minutes in a swinging‑bucket centrifuge cooled to 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect supernatant cell suspension
steps.instruction: Aspirate 1 ml of the cell‑containing supernatant, keeping the pipette tip away from the pelleted worm debris.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Dispense the collected supernatant through a 35‑µm nylon mesh filter into a 5 ml flow‑cytometry tube.

steps.title: Adjust cell suspension volume by strain
steps.instruction: For the control strain keep the total cell suspension at 1 ml; for the sorting strain perform an additional harvest to bring the total volume to 2 ml.

steps.title: Aliquot cells for RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer 70 µl of the cell suspension to 1 ml Qiazol and store at –80 °C for downstream RNA analysis; retain the remaining ~2 ml for FACS.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in L15‑10 media
steps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining worm slurry in 1 ml L15‑10 media (step listed twice in source; performed once).

steps.title: Count cells on TC20
steps.instruction: Load 10 µl of the cell suspension onto a Bio‑Rad TC20 automated cell‑counting slide.

steps.title: Dilute to target concentration
steps.instruction: If the measured concentration exceeds 1 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹, dilute the sample with L15‑10 media to 1 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹.

steps.title: Confirm fluorescence microscopically
steps.instruction: Microscopically verify that fluorescent cells are present in the cell suspension.

steps.title: Final pellet of worm slurry
steps.instruction: Pellet the worm slurry again at 500 rcf for 5 minutes in a swinging‑bucket centrifuge cooled to 4 °C.

steps.title: Separate cells from undissociated embryos
steps.instruction: Pellet undissociated embryos at 100 rcf for 1 minute in a swinging‑bucket centrifuge cooled to 4 °C; the dissociated cells remain in the supernatant. Visually confirm fluorescent cells are in the supernatant and absent from the pellet; adjust speed/time if needed.

steps.title: Harvest cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant containing the dissociated fluorescent cells for downstream FACS isolation and RNA‑seq analysis.
